title: In-Context Bias Propagation in LLM-Based Tabular Data Generation
abstract: arXiv:2506.09630v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for synthetic tabular data generation through in-context learning (ICL), offering a practical solution for data augmentation in data scarce scenarios. While prior work has shown the potential of LLMs to improve downstream task performance through augmenting underrepresented groups, these benefits often assume access to a subset of unbiased in-context examples, representative of the real dataset. In real-world settings, however, data is frequently noisy and demographically skewed. In this paper, we systematically study how statistical biases within in-context examples propagate to synthetic tabular data, showing that even mild in-context biases lead to global statistical distortions. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的表格数据生成中的上下文偏差传播
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地通过上下文学习（ICL）用于合成表格数据的生成，为数据稀缺场景下的数据增强提供了实用的解决方案。尽管先前的工作已经展示了LLM通过增强代表性不足群体来提升下游任务性能的潜力，但这些好处通常假设可以访问无偏的、能代表真实数据集的上下文示例子集。然而，在现实环境中，数据往往充满噪声且在人口统计分布上存在偏斜。在本文中，我们系统地研究了上下文示例中的统计偏差如何传播到合成表格数据中，结果表明即使是轻微的上下文偏差也会导致全局性的统计失真。我们进一步引入了一个对抗性场景，其中恶意贡献者可以通过一部分上下文示例向合成数据集注入偏差，最终损害下游模型的公平性。
tldr: 本文系统研究了基于LLM的合成表格数据生成中上下文示例偏差的传播机制，发现即使轻微的上下文偏差也会导致合成数据的全局统计失真，并揭示了恶意攻击者可通过注入有偏上下文示例来破坏下游模型公平性的对抗性风险。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies how biases in in-context examples propagate to LLM-generated synthetic tabular data, showing that even mild in-context biases cause global statistical distortions, and introduces an adversarial scenario where malicious contributors can inject bias to compromise downstream model fairness.
